Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support a complex data transformation and ERP modernization environment within a manufacturing organization.   Support ERP implementations and migrations, including moving data from legacy accounting/ERP platforms into Infor SyteLine 
  Analyze master data across customers, vendors, products/items, inventory, financials, manufacturing, engineering, and operations 
  Partner with system owners, Finance, Operations, IT, and other stakeholders to resolve data issues and dependencies 
  Use SQL and advanced Excel to extract, analyze, validate, and manipulate large datasets 
  Identify duplicate, incomplete, conflicting, or inaccurate records and recommend appropriate remediation 
  Troubleshoot issues across interconnected systems while considering upstream and downstream impacts 
 
 
  3+ years of experience in Data Analysis, Master Data Management, ERP data migration, data governance, or related work 
  Hands-on experience working with multiple ERP systems 
  Strong understanding of master data management, data mapping, normalization, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation 
  Strong SQL skills 
  Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query, XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and large dataset analysis 
  Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping tables, crosswalks, and validation standards 
  Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar systems and understand integrations and data dependencies 
  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills 
  Ability to work independently in a fast-moving, multi-system environment 
  This individual must be highly adaptable and able to quickly understand new systems, architecture, workflows, and data dependencies 
  Success in this role requires someone who can move fluidly between platforms and business teams rather than relying on a rigid approach or a single technology 
  Experience with Infor SyteLine/CloudSuite Industrial strongly preferred 
  Manufacturing or industrial ERP experience highly preferred
